headline: Middle East Chokepoint Oil Shipments Rose 19% in Third Quarter, EIA Says
summary: Collective oil shipments through key Middle Eastern chokepoints grew 19% in the third quarter of 2026, according to the US Energy Information Administration.
why: Middle Eastern maritime choke points, including the Strait of Hormuz and Bab el-Mandeb, carry a critical fraction of global seaborne crude and petroleum products.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Shifts in crude transit volumes through major Middle Eastern corridors influence global seaborne supply balances and freight pricing.
